zh-CN.hero_subtitle: 多 Agent 协作的科研自动化平台。摆脱真实环境约束，模拟真实实验，突破时空限制。
zh-CN.feature_1_desc: 从 Monod 动力学到 Chemostat 稳态，覆盖微生物实验全生命周期
zh-CN.feature_2_desc: 每个预测都带不确定性区间，告诉你「模型在说真话」还是「在猜」
zh-CN.feature_3_desc: 违反物理约束的预测被自动拦截，避免荒谬结论进入决策链

en.hero_subtitle: Multi-agent collaborative research automation platform. Break free from physical constraints, simulate real experiments, transcend time and space.
en.feature_1_desc: From Monod kinetics to Chemostat steady-state, covering the full microbiology experiment lifecycle
en.feature_2_desc: Every prediction comes with uncertainty bounds — you know when the model is truthful vs guessing
en.feature_3_desc: Physically implausible predictions are auto-rejected before entering the decision chain
en.feature_4_desc: Zero external deps (numpy + scipy). Runs anywhere: server, Colab, laptop.
